title_content_relation: Title premise matches a visually reviewed ranked-food recommendation montage.
content_summary: High-velocity ranked food recommendation montage. Sensory texture + convenience + repeated item reveals drive the edit rather than one sustained single-product demonstration.
reusable_editing_rules: Open on tactile/sensory macro action rather than a static packshot.
Front-load cuts: 10 detected changes by 5 s.
For list formats, switch item/benefit blocks every roughly 6–9 s while maintaining closeups.
Keep captions compact and away from core food texture.
confidence_notes: Direct visual review completed from first-frame, hook 5fps, whole-video 1fps and scene-change contact sheets.
Detected cut times are supporting evidence, not a substitute for sheet review.
Exact font family and direct sound characteristics are intentionally not fabricated.
VTT was used only to ground wording/timing.
